categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Adds a GitHub Actions workflow and helper scripts in .github/ to run periodic silent merge checks against master
categories.rationale: Automates detection of logical merge conflicts across open PRs before or after merge. This reduces contributor and maintainer friction, but is an optional tooling enhancement rather than a fix for broken builds or CI reliability.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Touches only .github/ workflow and script files; does not modify the test framework, test runners, harnesses, or test suites
categories.rationale: Although labeled 'Tests', the PR is purely CI orchestration and workflow automation covered by the build category rather than test infrastructure.
